name: Rizuhble's Come Here My Pawns
rows: Sell it once you're out of slots.
Cooldown halves when you cast it on a teammate.
Get after Warp Stone if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Opening Rounds for it.
One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.
A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.
Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.
Their team chains stuns and silences on you.
changes: Heroic Aura added (Kieran: heal support with Heroic Aura) in place of Long Range → Sharpshooter: same 3.2k, so the gun spike still lands at 4.8k (Opening Rounds 1.6k + Heroic Aura 3.2k) at 14.4k, and it gives 26% fire rate to you plus 17% bullet resist to everyone near you instead of long-range gun damage.

Extra Stamina → Stamina Mastery added (800 + 2.4k): pro Solomon buys Extra Stamina 55% early and Stamina Mastery 29% mid, it's in tracklock's and deadlocked.gg's core and in Kieran's played YaBoyCJ build; it fills the slot Spirit Burn held.

Grit added early (800, pro 70%) so Guardian Ward is an 800 upgrade at 16.8k. Health 4.8k now lands at 11.2k on Healing Nova (Extra Stamina + Grit + Nova), 6.4k on Enchanter's at 16k, 9.6k after Guardian Ward + Stamina Mastery.
Spirit Burn moved to rich (sell Enchanter's Emblem); the core now ends at exactly 48k instead of 51.2k, still 12 slots. Spikes: spirit 4.8k at 6.4k, health 4.8k at 11.2k, gun 4.8k at 14.4k.

Everything else matches tracklock pro: HV → Opening Rounds 87-92%, Extra Spirit 90%, Mystic Expansion 82%, Superior Cooldown 90%, Guardian Ward 69%, Greater Expansion 75%, Tankbuster 54%, Boundless 42%.

Ability order: mobalytics build-stats grid: Bishop 5-6, Knight 7-8, Queen 9, Rook 10-12, Queen 14-15, Bishop last; Kieran's in-game YaBoyCJ order is similar (Rook 10-12). Heal-support tweak: Knight maxed by 9 (T3 two allies + cleanse), Queen T1-T2 10-11 (execute), Rook 12-14, Queen T3, Bishop T3 last.

Item fit: Healing Nova → Rescue Beam (same 3.2k T3 green, same slot, so 4.8k health still lands at 11.2k; also built from Healing Rite). Solomon has no heal of his own and plays back placing pieces from 20m+ (Bishop 20m, Queen 30m). Nova only heals in an 18m circle around him, and it's in no public Solomon list (not tracklock pro or build, not lockbuilds top-30 where the lowest is 8.4%, not deadlocked). Rescue Beam heals a mate and yourself for 20% max health from 35m and can pull them in. It was in Kieran's in-game Chess Club Solomon. The Healing Rite and Counters notes are updated.
Order: 1123144223332441 (data-first redo, see a7/order_solomon.json).

Threshold: checked on the new order, nothing moved. Mystic Burst at 6.4k (75 spirit): Setup Bishop impact 70+2.0×75 = 220, Rook Battery 50+1.3×75 = 148 vs 80. Tankbuster at 30.4k (150 spirit): Rook Battery 245, Bishop impact 370 vs 165. Spirit Burn (rich, after the 48k core, 150+ spirit): Bishop 370 + Rook 245 = 615 in one combo vs 500.

Round 9: Mystic Expansion on the bishop moved out of lane (3.2k) to the start of Mid: extra placing range does little in a 1v1 lane, and tracklock.gg pro Solomon (last 30 days, 255 games, all after his Oct 9 release) buys it mid in 82% of games, never early. Mystic Burst moved from the 6.4k spike to just before Tankbuster in Late (pro: late 48%, Tankbuster late 54%). The spirit spike is now Extra Spirit, Improved Spirit, Compress Cooldown, Superior Cooldown = 4.8k at 8k souls (pro: Superior Cooldown 90% mid, Improved Spirit 76%). Grit and Extra Stamina moved into lane (pro early 70% and 55%), so 4.8k health now lands on Rescue Beam at 12k. Same items, same 48k.

Round 9: Worth a try box: Magic Carpet (12s flight at 7m/s, slow immune, +15% ability duration, +14 spirit; Solomon has no escape of his own; in YaBoyCJ's build Kieran plays) and Scourge (35m ally cast, 10s aura of 2.3% max health per second plus 40% spirit resist; Kingside Knight already throws that ally 13m into them; YaBoyCJ: 'insane with Kingside Knight').

Round 10: Echo Shard (6.4k, last core) out, Warp Stone (3.2k) in at the end of Mid. Since Jul 28 Echo Shard's cooldown is 30s + the rook's 21s, so one extra rook pair (about 245 damage at 150 spirit) every 51s; it's in no tracklock pro Solomon list (last 30 days, 255 games). Warp Stone is bought mid in 56% of pro games and Solomon has no escape of his own. Core 44.8k, 12 slots.

Round 11: added 'Another support on your team?' pivot: damage Solomon (Mystic Vulnerability, Mystic Reverb on the bishop, Escalating Exposure, Spirit Burn) in place of Heroic Aura, Guardian Ward, Divine Barrier and Refresher. Bishop impact 70 + 2.0x spirit clears Reverb's 100 at 17.6k. No early tier 4 run (Divine Barrier → Refresher is 38k+).

Round 12: default flipped to AoE damage (Kieran: Solomon default is AoE damage; support Solomon becomes its own build). Out of the core: Rescue Beam, Heroic Aura, Enchanter's Emblem. In: Mystic Vulnerability → Escalating Exposure (every bishop square, rook and queen tick stacks it), Slowing Hex (pro mid 32%), Mystic Reverb on the bishop (impact 70 + 2.0x spirit, cast every 3s via Move). Warp Stone moved up to land 4.8k health at 12k (Grit + Extra Stamina + Warp Stone). Tracklock pro Solomon (last 30 days, 255 games) is this build: Extra Spirit 90%, Superior Cooldown 90%, Mystic Expansion 82%, Guardian Ward 69%, Warp Stone 56%, Tankbuster 54%, no Rescue Beam or Heroic Aura.
Round 12: removed the old 'Another support on your team?' pivot box (role pivots become separate builds), the Worth a try box (Scourge) and with them the duplicate Spirit Burn.
Round 12: Mystic Burst/Tankbuster moved from Late to the end of Mid (16.8k/19.2k): bishop impact there is 70 + 2.0x 101 spirit = 272 (vs 80) and 70 + 2.0x 110 = 290 (vs 165).
Round 13: notes emptied per UPDATE 3 (only sells, swaps, slot locked, counters and verified tips kept); desc shortened to a style label (UPDATE 4).

Round 14: name 'Come Here My Pawns' (37 chars, style not obvious) -> 'Rizuhble's AoE Damage Solomon'. Slowing Hex out of the core (only one same-style source, as an early optional); Spirit Burn moves from the rich box (where it was the 'pricier version' of nothing in the build) into Late after Boundless Spirit: it is in all four same-style lockbuilds lists checked (official Spirit/Gun Hybrid Oct 19, Die Chance Oct 12, Queens Gambit Oct 17, Rook Assault Oct 11); bishop 370 + rook 245 at ~150 spirit clears 500. Rich box removed (nothing left that fits). Healing Rite out of the lane box (Kieran prefers Extra Regen; one clear pick). Counters notes made concrete and true (Dispel Magic doesn't stop piece placement; named heroes).

Round 15: name restored to 'Rizuhble's Come Here My Pawns Solomon' (Kieran cited it as a good style name; the code generator drops the prefix when too long), desc stays 'AoE damage Solomon'. Divine Barrier had an empty note, which the site and code generator fill with the default 'Expensive late upgrade to Guardian Ward. Same job as Counterspell...' (not allowed, and not the same job): now a real tip (CooldownReductionPctOnOthers 50). Counters description was 113 chars: 'for it' dropped.

Round 20: Refresher moved from core to the end of the late list (luxury); Echo Shard on Rook Battery takes its core slot (Echo can't imbue ults). New late list Diviner's Kevlar, Cheat Death, Refresher with sells; core+late 78.4k.
Round 23: Dispel Magic out of Counters. Kingside Knight T3 self-cast removes all debuffs after the move (RemoveDebuffs), and this build maxes Knight by point 13, so the kit already does Dispel's job.
Round 25: ability order 1123144223332441 -> 1123144123343242 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle). Compress Cooldown imbue 4 -> 3.
